user.title: Create Virtual Light
user.description: Set up your virtual light entity. Give it a name and configure the initial state.

color_modes.title: Color Modes
color_modes.description: Select which color modes this virtual light should support. Pick the modes that match the type of light you want to simulate.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Choose which animation effects to enable for this virtual light. These will appear as effects in the light controls.

init.title: Virtual Light Settings
init.description: Update the configuration for this virtual light.
